text: Digit's platform is built for software that does more than answer questions or wait for instructions.
It combines specialized agents, shared knowledge, execution systems, and human oversight into one operating layer.

headline.text: A connected system for running the business.

body: Running a business requires more than a capable model or a collection of isolated agents.
Digit combines software for coordination, execution, knowledge, oversight, and specialized work into one operating platform.
Each part has a different job, but they work from the same operation.
overview.note: Illustrative platform model. Not live operational data.

neo.name: Executive Layer
neo.body: Coordinates priorities, work, decisions, and what needs attention.

mission-control.name: Mission Control
mission-control.body: Shows what is happening across the business and gives people a place to inspect and direct it.

cerebro.name: Cerebro
cerebro.body: Keeps institutional knowledge connected and available across future work.

agents.name: Agents
agents.body: Perform focused work across research, analysis, creation, review, monitoring, and other business functions.

morpheus.name: Operations Layer
morpheus.body: Provides the execution environment that lets software carry work through approved systems and capabilities.

body: Neo keeps priorities, active work, decisions, problems, and opportunities connected as the business moves forward.
Neo can coordinate work across different parts of the business, bring the right problems to a person, and keep routine operations moving within his limits.
The goal is simple: people should be able to lead the company without personally coordinating every piece of work inside it.

items.title: Priorities
items.body: Keep active work connected to business goals and priorities.

items.title: Coordination
items.body: Connect work across systems, teams, and specialized capabilities.

items.title: Decisions
items.body: Keep routine work moving while escalating decisions that require human judgment.

items.title: Attention
items.body: Bring forward important problems, decisions, and exceptions without unnecessary noise.

headline.text: A clear view of the entire operation.

missionControl.lead: Mission Control is the human interface for Digit's autonomous operations.
body: It brings the business into one place so people can understand what is happening without digging through agents, logs, tools, and disconnected systems.
Operations, businesses, financials, objectives, decisions, learning, company knowledge, and system health in one view. This gives owners visibility into the parts of their business that matter most

items.title: Company
items.body: Understand the state of the organization and its businesses.

items.title: Operations
items.body: See what is active, what has finished, and what is blocked.

items.title: Decisions
items.body: Review the actions that need human judgment before they continue.

items.title: Financials
items.body: Inspect revenue, expenses, profit, budgets, and financial activity where available.

items.title: Learning
items.body: See what the business has learned from recent work and experiments.

items.title: System
items.body: Understand whether the software and connected services are operating normally.

missionControl.caption: Illustrative interface. Not live company data.

cerebro.intro: Businesses generate useful knowledge every day through research, decisions, results, procedures, and operating experience.
cerebro.lead: Cerebro turns scattered knowledge into connected business memory.
body: A record can retain what was learned, where it came from, how it relates to other knowledge, and where it may be useful again. That gives future work access to more than the current conversation or task.
Cerebro is the institutional memory behind the business.

knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.body: Information the business expects to use again.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.body: The source material behind a conclusion or decision.

governance.title: Decisions
governance.body: Important choices and the reasoning or context attached to them.

procedures.title: Procedures
procedures.body: How recurring work should be handled.

organization.title: Organization
organization.body: Context about businesses, roles, responsibilities, and operating structure.

experience.title: Learning
experience.body: Lessons produced through results, experiments, failures, and repeated patterns.

cerebro.explorerNote: Illustrative records showing how different kinds of company knowledge can relate to one another.

closing.headline: The platform is only useful if it can operate in the real world.
body: The deeper engineering behind Digit covers execution, knowledge, integrations, governance, reliability, and the systems required to carry intelligent work across a business.
